title: Sparkly crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Crown base -->
  <rect x='22' y='60' width='56' height='20' rx='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Crown base highlight -->
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='52' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFEA00'/>
  <!-- Crown band gem -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='5' fill='#FF3B3B'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='#FF9999'/>
  <!-- Left point -->
  <polygon points='22,60 30,25 38,60' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='24,58 30,30 36,58' fill='#FFEA00'/>
  <!-- Middle point -->
  <polygon points='42,60 50,15 58,60' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='45,58 50,22 55,58' fill='#FFEA00'/>
  <!-- Right point -->
  <polygon points='62,60 70,25 78,60' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='64,58 70,30 76,58' fill='#FFEA00'/>
  <!-- Left point gem -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#3BB8FF'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#A8E4FF'/>
  <!-- Middle point gem -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FF3B3B'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40.5' r='1.8' fill='#FF9999'/>
  <!-- Right point gem -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#3BB8FF'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#A8E4FF'/>
  <!-- Sparkle top left -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <polygon points='12,18 14,14 16,18 20,20 16,22 14,26 12,22 8,20' opacity='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle top right -->
  <g fill='#FFEA00'>
    <polygon points='82,12 84,8 86,12 90,14 86,16 84,20 82,16 78,14' opacity='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle bottom left -->
  <g fill='#A8E4FF'>
    <polygon points='10,80 12,76 14,80 18,82 14,84 12,88 10,84 6,82' opacity='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small sparkle right -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <polygon points='88,50 90,47 92,50 95,52 92,54 90,57 88,54 85,52' opacity='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#FFEA00'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#A8E4FF'/>
</svg>
